methods.label: Subtract from one ten
methods.explanation:
Write \(30\) as \(20+10\), so \(6\) can be subtracted from the last ten:
\[
30-6=20+(10-6)=20+4=24.
\]
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary mental subtraction with regrouping, supported by tens and ones and subtraction within 10.
